sloka: राम लक्ष्मणयोः वासाम् अरण्ये सह सीतया ।राघवस्य च बाणेन वालिनः च तथा वधः ॥४-५६-१५॥
transliteration: rāma lakṣmaṇayoḥ vāsām araṇye saha sītayā ।rāghavasya ca bāṇena vālinaḥ ca tathā vadhaḥ ॥4-56-15॥

translations.english: 'The exile of Rama and Lakshmana into the forest along with Sita, so also the death of Vali and of the demons in the hands of Rama due to his anger are all evil consequences of a boon granted to Kaikeyi.'
